description: This file defines a singleton-like utility called ConfigStore that manages application configuration settings, including loading and saving configurations locally and remotely. It includes nested structures, actors for concurrency, and functions for network communication with a gateway.

classes.name: OverrideStore
classes.description: An actor class that manages thread-safe access to the Overrides structure, allowing setting of override configurations.

methods.name: isRemoteMode
methods.description: Determines asynchronously whether the application should operate in remote mode based on overrides or connection state.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the configuration data, either from remote gateway or local fallback.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Asynchronously saves the configuration data either remotely or locally, depending on the mode and overrides.

methods.name: loadFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches the configuration snapshot from the remote gateway asynchronously.

methods.name: saveToGateway
methods.description: Sends the configuration data to the remote gateway asynchronously.

methods.name: _testSetOverrides
methods.description: Test utility function to set override configurations during debugging.

methods.name: _testClearOverrides
methods.description: Test utility function to clear override configurations during debugging.
